en: Black-and-white view over a coastal village nestled among rocky hills. Dozens of wooden houses with steep roofs are scattered across the landscape, with a white church standing on a slight rise in the background. Vegetation and small gardens fill the spaces between homes. At the bottom left, the caption 'BOVALLSTRAND.' is printed, and at the bottom right there is a small triangular logo with the number 4099.
